# Dr. Abhijeet R Nalkar — Orthopaedic Surgeon

> Orthopaedic surgeon practising in Ahilyanagar and Rahuri. Focus areas include robotic joint replacement, total knee and hip replacement, unicondylar knee replacement, and knee and shoulder arthroscopy.

## Doctor
- Name: Dr. Abhijeet R Nalkar
- Qualification: MBBS, DNB (Ortho)
- Specialty: Orthopaedic Surgery

## Practice Locations
- Saideep Sahyadri Hospital — Ahilyanagar
- Nalkar Orthopedic Clinic — Rahuri

## Confirmed Treatment Areas
1. Robotic Joint Replacement
2. Total Knee Replacement (TKA) — Subvastus Approach, Robotic-Assisted
3. Total Hip Replacement (THR) — Direct Anterior Approach (DAA), Robotic-Assisted
4. Unicondylar Knee Replacement (UKR)
5. Knee Scope (Knee Arthroscopy)
6. Shoulder Scope (Shoulder Arthroscopy)
